chelsea:minority:2026-09-16:25.6.text: Clearlake already held 61.5% but shared power under an unusual governance split with Boehly that had soured by 2024. Buying out the 25.6% hands Clearlake sole final say, so the £950M buys control rights on top of economics.

los-angeles-angels:control:2026-09-01:na.text: Angel Stadium sits on public land ringed by about 130 acres of surface parking near three freeways and a train station, next to the OCVibe project at Honda Center. Moreno listed the club in August 2022, pulled it nine months later, and said this spring he had no interest in selling. When the 80-year-old owner finally reopened the door, a Los Angeles MLB franchise came to market for the first time since 2003.

liverpool:minority:2026-08-14:30.text: 1892 Holdings pairs the Mittal Family Trusts with Jeff Bezos (via K5 Sports) and Eduardo Saverin's family office. Trophy capital at that scale pays for access to a global club, not for near-term cash yield.

new-york-yankees:minority:2026-08-11:8.text: Apollo Sports Capital is buying into Yankee Global Enterprises, which holds YES Network, Legends Hospitality and stakes in NYCFC and AC Milan, and its CEO Al Tylis takes a new board seat. oakland-athletics:minority:2026-07-23:na.text: Harbinger's $50M implies about $3.8B post-money for the A's plus their $2B, 33,000-seat domed ballpark on the Las Vegas Strip. The Forbes mark of about $2B covers the team only, so most of the gap is the stadium asset.

Harbinger Sports Partners, with Mark Cuban as GP and president, launched in May 2025 targeting $750M for 10 to 12 stakes across MLB, NBA and NFL, and the A's is its first deal. A new fund deploying its first check buys access, and Cuban said the goal is to make his investors a lot of money.

toronto-maple-leafs:minority:2026-07-06:.text: Rogers already owns the Blue Jays, Rogers Centre and Sportsnet, and full MLSE ownership lets it fold the Leafs, Raptors, TFC and Argos into one sports and media entity. miami-marlins:minority:2026-06-01:15.text: Sherman sold 15% mostly to pay down debt and to cushion against a proposed salary floor of $150M to $171.2M, against a Marlins payroll near $79M. toronto-maple-leafs:control:2024-09-18:3.text: Rogers already owned the Blue Jays, Rogers Centre and Sportsnet and had put $14B into Canadian sports over the prior decade. columbus-crew-sc:minority:2026-05-29:37.text: Nationwide is a Columbus-headquartered insurer, the Crew's jersey sponsor since 2021, and part of the group awarded Columbus's 2028 NWSL franchise. A hometown strategic buyer pays for civic and brand alignment, not just financial return.

columbus-crew-sc:minority:2025-07-01:10.text: Sportico valued the Crew at $730M earlier in 2025, so the $900M mark is a $170M step-up in months. The Crew won the 2023 MLS Cup and 2024 Leagues Cup and has sold out nearly every match since the $314M Lower.com Field opened in 2021.

san-diego-padres:control:2026-05-02:40.text: The Seidlers put the club up for sale in November 2024, a year after Peter Seidler's death, and a suit by his widow Sheel against his brothers over the trust had to settle first. carolina-hurricanes:minority:2026-03-05:.text: Dundon controls 80 acres around Raleigh's Lenovo Center and is building a mixed-use sports and entertainment district there. sporting-kansas-city:control:2026-01-20:.text: MLS team values are up 121% since 2019 to an average near $690M, with LAFC at $1.25B and Inter Miami at $1.2B. Mallouk, CEO of Creative Planning, is a Kansas City native, a Sporting KC minority owner since 2022 and a Royals investor. An insider local buyer closed after more than a year of talks and paid right at the market mark.

Mallouk moves to about 80% of the economics, but the Illig family, now below 10%, keeps day-to-day operations and the MLS board seat. Majority equity without operating control caps what a buyer pays for the stake.

pittsburgh-penguins:control:2025-12-18:n.text: Local TV viewership on SportsNet Pittsburgh fell 38% last season, the third-largest drop in the NHL, and the arena ran at 88.4% capacity, third-lowest in the league. minnesota-twins:minority:2025-12-17:20.text: The Twins carry about $500M of debt, and the Pohlads sold just over 20% to cut it significantly and position the club for a future sale. A liquidity-driven LP sale by a family that could not find a control buyer.

austin-fc:minority:2025-07-15:na.text: All five new investors are Austin-based wealth: Peak6 co-founders Jenny Just and Matt Hulsizer, Nvidia board member since 1993 Tench Coxe, Securonix CTO Tanuj Gulati and Magnetar's Dave Snyderman. utah-hockey-club:control:2024-04-18:100.text: The Coyotes were stuck in 4,600-seat Mullett Arena after the Tempe arena referendum failed, with no timeline for a new building. The NHL paid Meruelo $1B and moved the hockey assets, a league-forced exit rather than a market sale.
